{{Differential equations}}

'''Group analysis of differential equations''' is a branch of mathematics that studies the symmetry properties of [[differential equation]]s with respect to various transformations of independent and dependent variables. It includes methods and applied aspects of [[differential geometry]], [[Lie group]]s and [[Lie algebra|algebras]] theory, [[calculus of variations]] and is, in turn, a powerful research tool in theories of [[Ordinary differential equation|ODEs]], [[Partial differential equation|PDEs]], [[Mathematical physics|mathematical]] and [[theoretical physics]].<ref>{{cite book |last=Ovsyannikov|first= Lev V.|title=Group analysis of differential equations|series=|volume=|publisher=Academic Press|year=1982|isbn=9781483219066|mr=|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=YpPiBQAAQBAJ&pg=PA1}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last=Olver|first= Peter J.|title=Applications of Lie groups to differential equations|series=Graduate Texts in Mathematics|volume=107|publisher=Springer-Verlag New York|year=1986|isbn=978-1-4684-0274-2|doi=10.1007/978-1-4684-0274-2|issn=0072-5285|mr=|url=https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9781468402742}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last=Ibragimov|first= Nail H.|title=Transformation groups applied to mathematical physics|series=Mathematics and its Applications|volume=3|publisher=Springer Netherlands|year=1985|isbn=978-90-277-1847-1|issn=0169-6378|mr=|url=https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9789027718471}}
</ref>
